faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about SoulSync

q1.question: How do I create a profile?
q1.answer: Click on "Register Free" button, fill in your basic details, upload your photos, and complete your profile information. The process takes only 5 minutes.

q2.question: Is my information safe and private?
q2.answer: Yes, absolutely. We use bank-level encryption to protect your data. You have full control over your privacy settings and can choose what information to show on your profile.

q3.question: How does the matching algorithm work?
q3.answer: Our AI-powered algorithm analyzes over 50 compatibility factors including education, profession, interests, values, and preferences to suggest your best matches.

q4.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
q4.answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for all premium subscriptions. If you're not satisfied, contact our support team for a full refund.

q5.question: How do I verify my profile?
q5.answer: Go to your profile settings and click on "Verify Profile". You'll need to upload a valid government ID and take a selfie. Verification is usually completed within 24 hours.
